item.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Hardening Container Storage with Bind Mount Options and EmptyDir Permissions
item.description: Kubernetes v1.37 brings important storage security features: emptyDir permission modes and bind mount options. (1 source: kubernetesblog)

item.title: Kubernetes Multi-Cluster Project Karmada Reaches CNCF Graduation
item.description: The Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) announced on September 2026 that Karmada, a multi-cluster and multi-cloud Kubernetes orchestration project, has graduated. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Microsoft Open-Sources TauGrid to Simplify AI Workload Management on Kubernetes
item.description: Microsoft has open-sourced TauGrid, a cloud-native platform designed to manage, schedule, and monitor AI workloads on GPU-enabled Kubernetes clusters. By Sergio De Simone (1 source: infoq)
